svg.title: Nouns, verbs, and what OFFSET makes you read
svg.desc: A grid crossing two resources with GET, POST, PATCH and DELETE, filled with the status codes each returns, and an invented POST /getOrder cell crossed out in red. Beside it a single error envelope card with type, title, status, detail and errors. Below, offset pagination is drawn as 500 000 rows read and discarded in 693.9 ms against a keyset query that seeks straight to the same 20 rows in 1.7 milliseconds.
